rationale: The review relentlessly favors the Vegas replica with petty, specific grievances (lines, lack of Fat Tuesday/slot machines, 'rusty' appearance) and defends the one-star rating without any self-awareness. The writer never concedes the Paris landmark's grandeur and treats it as an inconvenience throughout.
quote: Save your airfare. I don’t understand why everyone hypes this place up so much when the one in Nevada is infinitely better.
